version.changelog:
- Increased searchable article count from 187K+ to 200K+
- Added machine learning (ML) article classification: articles are now categorized by embeddings, not just feed labels; tags are auto-assigned by topic and country
- Updated documentation throughout to reflect these improvements and the larger dataset

llm.summary: This skill is internally consistent: it only instructs the agent to call https://agenttimes.live endpoints with curl to fetch news, weather, and prices and does not request extra credentials, installs, or unusual system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the instructions: SKILL.md provides curl examples against agenttimes.live endpoints for search, trending, weather, crypto prices, and subscriptions. The only declared requirement is curl, which is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to making HTTP GET/POST requests to agenttimes.live and returning JSON; they do not instruct reading local files or unrelated environment variables. One caveat: the skill exposes a /subscribe webhook feature (POST /subscribe) — using it will send data to a webhook URL (user-supplied). Users should avoid including sensitive secrets or PII in queries or subscription payloads and ensure they control any webhook endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This is low risk because nothing is written to disk and no external archives or packages are downloaded.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. That aligns with its public, read-oriented API usage; nothing appears disproportionate.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there is no mechanism to persist or modify other skills or global agent configuration. The skill does not request elevated or persistent privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its stated purpose, but be aware that using it makes network requests to agenttimes.live and (if you enable subscriptions) will deliver data to webhook endpoints you provide. Do not include passwords, API keys, or other sensitive secrets in queries or subscription payloads. If you need to rely on this service for sensitive workflows, verify the service's identity and privacy policy (https://agenttimes.live), test the endpoints manually with curl first, and restrict webhook URLs to endpoints you control.
